from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=set(cnt)-{bg}
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for color in colors:
        pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color}
        # Complete each rectangle whose four corners are marked with this color.
        rows=sorted({r for r,c in pts}); cols=sorted({c for r,c in pts})
        for i,r1 in enumerate(rows):
            for r2 in rows[i+1:]:
                for j,c1 in enumerate(cols):
                    for c2 in cols[j+1:]:
                        if all(p in pts for p in ((r1,c1),(r1,c2),(r2,c1),(r2,c2))):
                            for c in range(c1,c2+1):
                                if out[r1][c]==bg: out[r1][c]=2
                                if out[r2][c]==bg: out[r2][c]=2
                            for r in range(r1,r2+1):
                                if out[r][c1]==bg: out[r][c1]=2
                                if out[r][c2]==bg: out[r][c2]=2
        # Complete clearly indicated multi-point horizontal/vertical strokes.
        for r in range(h):
            cs=[c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
            if len(cs)>=3:
                for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
                    if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
        for c in range(w):
            rs=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==color]
            if len(rs)>=3:
                for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
                    if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    return out
